C0195.title: Python-based Weibo bulk following and mutual following
C0195.summary: This CSDN blog post describes a method for bulk following on Weibo using Python scripts. The approach involves logging into a Weibo account, joining mutual-follow groups to collect large numbers of user IDs, and then programmatically executing bulk follow actions to rapidly grow followers through reciprocal following.
